cohort: A total of 335 pregnant women with a mean age of 28.74 years and a mean gestational age of 39.50 weeks were included in the study.
finding: The intensity of fear of childbirth was relatively high among pregnant women in the third trimester, with a significantly higher rate of requests for cesarean section in those with very intense fear.
mod_finding: Women experiencing very intense fear of childbirth demonstrated a much higher rate of requesting cesarean section compared to those with no or intense fear.
